name: SQLMap
summary: An open-source penetration testing tool that automates the process of detecting and exploiting SQL injection flaws and taking over database servers.
highlights: -hh — Show advanced help message and exit
-g — Process Google dork results as target URLs
--data — Data string to be sent through POST (e.g. "id=1")
--random-agent — Use randomly selected HTTP User-Agent header value
--proxy — Use a proxy to connect to the target URL
